evaluation_type: deterministic 1000-example subset of prepared validation data
notes: The baseline and Context Adapter are evaluated on exactly the same validation examples.
This is not an official DocHPLT test set.
The evaluation uses a deterministic subset of the prepared validation data.
The Context Adapter is an experimental context-fusion mechanism built on sentence-level NLLB-200.
Source-side context is retrieved without using target/reference text for ranking.
The context encoder and NLLB backbone remain frozen during evaluation.
Only the trained Context Adapter checkpoint is loaded as the learned context-fusion component.
